svg.aria-label: StreamLoRA, work in progress: a continual-learning forecaster for laptop telemetry with drift detection, conformal intervals and gated model promotion. On 3.3 hours of real telemetry, across four experiment arms, it made 306 promotions, 132 rejections and 35 automatic rollbacks. The picture is its dashboard timeline of drift and adaptation events.
svg.title: StreamLoRA, work in progress: a continual-learning forecaster for laptop telemetry with drift detection, conformal intervals and gated model promotion. On 3.3 hours of real telemetry, across four experiment arms, it made 306 promotions, 132 rejections and 35 automatic rollbacks. The picture is its dashboard timeline of drift and adaptation events.
svg.text: A forecaster that learns how a laptop behaves from 38
signals sampled every 5 seconds, flags drift, promotes a new
model only through a gate, and rolls it back if it does worse.
Python · NumPy · PyTorch · LoRA (PEFT) · FastAPI · SQLite
